title: Fill the Banner
story: Chilaka is printing the scoreboard. Fill the gaps so the variables appear inside the sentence.
hints: Inside an f-string, curly brackets hold the name of a variable.
The first blank is the name variable, the second is the score variable.
socratic: What do the curly brackets do inside an f-string?
Which variable belongs in each gap?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Banner”?
